name: Yukiguni Factory Co., Ltd.
summary: Yukiguni Factory Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of mushrooms and other food products under the Yukiguni brand name in Japan. Its products include Maitake Kiwami, Maitake Kiwami White, Eringi, Buna-Shimeji, Daikoku Hon-Shimeji Tamba Shimeji, and button mushrooms; mushroom meat; health foods; and Maitake and Eringi rice mix. The company was formerly known as Yukiguni Maitake Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yukiguni Factory Co., Ltd. in April 2025. Yukiguni Factory Co., Ltd. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Minamiuonuma, Japan.
